Df3NusJTkez.caption:
🍁 Discovering Japanese Culture in Autumn 🇯🇵

The Misses visited the Northern Culture Museum in Niigata, Japan!

Once the residence of the wealthy Ito family, the museum showcases traditional Japanese architecture, beautiful gardens, and the rich history of the family.

Surrounded by the beauty of the gardens and historic architecture, the Misses had a wonderful opportunity to experience Japan’s traditional culture and heritage.

It was a special moment filled with the beauty of autumn in Japan! 🍁✨

ミスたちが訪れたのは、新潟県にある「北方文化博物館」！

かつての豪農・伊藤家の歴史を今に伝える、伝統的な日本建築と美しい庭園が魅力の場所です。

四季折々の表情を見せる庭園や、歴史を感じる趣ある建物を通して、日本の伝統文化や美しさに触れるひとときとなりました。

日本の秋ならではの景色とともに、心に残る特別な時間を過ごしました🍂✨

DfvwAFrMXCk.caption:
🇪🇸 Miss International Spain 2026 – Laura Dowell lauradowell 

Laura Dowell, Miss International Spain 2026, is an AI engineer who believes in the power of technology to create a better future.

Through her work with artificial intelligence, she explores new ways to make education more creative, accessible, and engaging. She has developed an educational app that allows children to create their own interactive stories, encouraging them to learn, imagine, and express themselves in new ways.

Her commitment to making a difference goes beyond technology. Since 2022, she has also been volunteering with Community TechAid, helping bring technology and educational opportunities to those who need them most.

Laura believes that while technology continues to evolve, what truly matters is how we care for and support one another. She hopes to inspire a future where innovation and compassion go hand in hand.

Her message is clear: a better future begins when we use our knowledge and creativity to help others.

This video is part of the “Beauties for SDGs” project, inspired by Miss International’s values of Peace, Intelligence, and Compassion.

Miss International Netherlands 🇳🇱 -
Isabel Cramer@isabel_c_soleil 

Isabel Cramer, Miss International Netherlands 2026, is a literary studies master's graduate and fashion designer who aspires to become an author. She hopes to take her creativity further and write a book that inspires many people.

Through her platform "Climate Creatives," Isabel shows that living sustainably can be a creative challenge rather than a burden. With her passion for sewing, she transforms leftover materials into gowns worth cherishing, giving existing resources new life instead of treating fashion as disposable. She believes climate action begins when we feel connected to what we want to protect, and that creativity is the bridge between caring and doing.

Her message is clear: we are not separate from nature, but a part of it. She wants to help people realize why it matters to build a greener, brighter future for the generations to come.

Vice President Ansah Meets Miss International Africa, Miss Universe Zimbabwe 2025

The beauty queens also highlighted their collaboration with the Government of Zimbabwe and their work with young girls and boys living with disabilities across the African continent.

She described them as icons and good leaders who are serving as positive role models for young people in their respective countries.

The beauty queens also presented Vice President Ansah with a gift of Zimbabwean national fabric, an initiative facilitated by the First Lady of Zimbabwe, Auxillia Mnangagwa.

DckcW6-IvT9.caption:
realdanielacosio 
Es una de las modelos mexicanas con mayor trayectoria y proyección internacional. Originaria de La Paz, Baja California Sur, su historia en el mundo de la belleza comenzó en Nuestra Belleza México 2005, donde representó a su estado, obtuvo el reconocimiento de Nuestra Modelo y se convirtió en primera finalista y suplente del certamen.

A partir de ahí comenzó una destacada carrera internacional que la llevó a trabajar en algunas de las principales capitales de la moda, como Nueva York, Milán y París, y a desfilar para reconocidos diseñadores y casas de moda como Giorgio Armani, Jean Paul Gaultier, Vivienne Westwood, Marchesa, Guess y Georges Hobeika.

A lo largo de su trayectoria, Daniela ha sido imagen y ha participado en campañas internacionales para importantes firmas de moda y belleza como Maybelline New York, L’Oréal, Clarins, Pantene, Ralph Lauren, Victoria’s Secret, Abercrombie & Fitch, Guess y Express, entre muchas otras. Su trabajo también ha aparecido en publicaciones internacionales como Vogue, Elle y Harper’s Bazaar.

Su éxito comercial la llevó además a formar parte del ranking “Money Girls” de Models.com, que reconocía a algunas de las modelos con mayor éxito comercial dentro de la industria internacional, consolidando una carrera de más de dos décadas como uno de los rostros mexicanos con mayor presencia en el mundo de la moda.

DckcRbSo-Dx.caption:
aaronmercury 
Actor, creador y referente de una nueva generación, Aarón Mercury llega a Miss Universe México 2026.

Su autenticidad y capacidad para conectar con millones y marcar tendencias lo han convertido en una de las figuras más relevantes de su generación, con una carrera que hoy trasciende las redes y llega también a la actuación. ✨

Dckb7SXIDOF.caption:
ilda.ledesma 
Es una reconocida y destacada empresaria en el sector turístico, hotelero y de propiedad vacacional en Baja California Sur.
Es socia fundadora del emblemático y exitoso proyecto Corazón Cabo Resort & Spa, y a lo largo de su trayectoria profesional, ha tenido una participación activa en importantes asociaciones empresariales, entre ellos Asudéstico, AMEXME, Club Skal, siempre promoviendo la colaboración, desarrollo y competitividad dentro del sector turístico y empresarial del Estado.

De2EYVTRwkS.caption:
Because beauty is truly born Beyond The Crown ❤️‍🩹

Presenting my advocacy project for Miss Universe 2026. “Dare To Be Yourself” is an initiative that stems from my own personal experience with school bullying, an issue that’s still relevant in our classrooms today. Through this project, I aim to reach schools all around Chile and hopefully the world to talk with students about bullying prevention, give them resources to find help if needed and also remind them of the importance of nourishing their essences no matter what others may say.

I was able to rewrite my story with my own words when others tried to do it for me. It is now my dream to inspire children and young people to do the same.

I am so moved to be given this platform to be an actual agent of change. This is just the beginning. 

Follow our project here atreveteasertu.cl and vote for it through the MU Fan app ✨

A través de este proyecto, busco llegar a colegios de todo Chile y, ojalá, del mundo, para conversar con los estudiantes sobre la prevención del bullying, entregarles herramientas para encontrar ayuda cuando lo necesiten y recordarles la importancia de cultivar su esencia, sin importar lo que los demás puedan decir.

DeNuTkGkcXT.caption:
Recuerdos de mi primera vez en Puerto Rico 🇵🇷 

Qué hermoso día lleno de cultura y goce. Empezamos visitando la Hacienda Muñoz (hacienda_munoz) en San Lorenzo donde aprendí sobre la producción del café de especialidad boricua y también sobre la historia de las fincas en el país. 

Luego nos deleitamos con comida puertorriqueña tradicional en Zafra (zafradelcaribe_ ) donde cada plato hacía bailar al paladar. 

Después visitamos en faro Punta Tuna en Maunabo, un lugar que durante siglos fue la estrella guía de los barcos que llegaban a la isla.

Y finalizamos el día en Río Grande, donde las vistas del imponente Yunque, el único bosque tropical lluvioso en el sistema forestal nacional de Estados Unidos, fueron la imagen perfecta para finalizar el día. 

Gracias cristiandianapr y tiagocristinaa por acompañarme y hacer de este viaje algo aún más memorable 💗 Mañana seguiremos #DescubriendoLaIsla

DdT76ygDgfF.caption:
Meet Miss Universe Canada 2026, Aslihan Morali. 🇨🇦

Aslihan’s journey is one shaped by resilience, opportunity and purpose. After immigrating to Canada from Türkiye as a young girl and being raised by a single mother, she grew up with a deep appreciation for education, perseverance and the freedom to dream beyond one’s circumstances.

Today, she carries that story with her as she prepares to represent Canada on the Miss Universe stage in Puerto Rico.

For Aslihan, the crown represents far more than a title. It is a platform to connect with communities, advocate for education and opportunity, and remind others that where you begin does not determine where you are going.

We are proud to stand behind a Canadian representative who leads with authenticity, kindness and purpose, and we look forward to sharing this journey with all of you as she takes Canada to the Miss Universe stage. 🇨🇦✨

The road to Miss Universe begins now.

DdSA6EfTaj-.caption:
Reliving the crowning of our 2026 Miss Universe Canada, Aslihan Morali! We have no doubt that she will represent Canada proudly at the 75th Miss Universe Canada pageant in November in Puerto Rico ! 

As a child, Aslihan Morali walked across the Buffalo-Niagara bridge into Canada as a refugee with two suitcases and a dream. Today she is a model, humanitarian, and founder of Leap Global Voices, delivering educational resources to children in the Philippines, sponsoring girls’ education in Türkiye, and leading empowerment workshops across Canada. A longtime supporter of the SickKids Hospital Burn & Plastics Gala, trained by world-renowned supermodel Coco Rocha, and guided by faith and purpose, Aslihan proves every day that where you begin never determines where you are going.

MELINA SVAB - REGIONAL DIRECTOR OF WESTERN ONTARIO 

Miss Universe Canada is proud to welcome Melina Svab as the official regional Director of Western Ontario! 

Melina Svab brings more than a decade of experience in the pageant world, pairing deep industry expertise with a strategic, people-first approach to mentorship. With a proven track record across a diverse range of competitions, including Miss Windsor, Miss LaSalle, Miss Tecumseh, and Miss Universe Canada, Melina has developed a well-rounded perspective on what it takes to cultivate confident, high-performing titleholders and standout delegates. As a former Miss Tecumseh titleholder, she brings authentic, firsthand insight into the demands of the stage and the responsibility of representing a community with excellence, integrity, and purpose.

Melina is a graduate of the University of Windsor, where she earned a degree in Visual Arts and Psychology, an interdisciplinary foundation that uniquely positions her to support delegates through both a creative and human-centered lens. Her approach blends presentation, branding, and stage presence with a strong understanding of mindset, confidence-building, and personal growth helping delegates refine not just how they show up, but how they evolve throughout the process.

Df2Gulht7gY.caption:
FROM 1952 TO 2026 – 75 YEARS OF MISS UNIVERSE ✨👑🇩🇰

From the very first Miss Universe competition in 1952, when Hanne Sørensen proudly represented Denmark, to Fie Rose, representing our country at the historic 75th edition of Miss Universe in Puerto Rico.

Two women. Two generations. One dream. 🇩🇰

For 75 editions, Miss Universe has celebrated beauty, confidence, ambition, and the power of women from around the world.

Today, we honor Denmark’s journey through the decades, from where it all began to the incredible women who continue to carry our flag onto the international stage.

Different eras, the same Danish pride.

As Fie Rose takes part in this milestone edition, we celebrate the past, embrace the present, and look forward to the future of Miss Universe Denmark.

A legacy that began in 1952. A story that continues today✨

#MissUniverseDenmark #MissUniverse2026 #75thMissUniverse #FieRose #MissUniverse #Denmark

De2W3lXsHn2.caption:
Every child deserves to know: I matter. I belong. My future holds possibilities.

For Miss Universe Estonia, Emili Denneng, this is personal. Having experienced bullying herself, she knows how much it matters to feel accepted and believed in.

Kambuka is a youth club in Estonia that organizes camps and activities where children can find friends, discover their strengths, and feel free to be themselves. A place where “Can I join?” becomes “We’re so glad you’re here.”

But some families cannot afford that opportunity. Emili wants to help change this.
Your support can help cover a child’s participation. Your time and skills can help them feel heard and encouraged.

We cannot erase what a child has been through. But together, we can help them believe that their future can be different. 🤍

Df7TnBcEQ7E.caption:
Closed-Door Interview Look 🇯🇵✨

Sayuki is in her closed-door interview right now, proudly representing Japan. Sending her all our love and support🤍

Designed for the Miss Universe interview, this look expresses quiet confidence and intellect, inner strength, and the determination to take flight on the world stage.

A sharp white vest paired with black trousers creates a poised silhouette.

The long cape flowing from the shoulders features cranes reminiscent of Japanese ink paintings and a golden circle. Elegant and composed at rest, the design brings the cranes to life in movement, as though they are spreading their wings.

Inspired by the Japanese appreciation for space and the fluidity of brushstrokes, this creation embodies a woman who is thoughtful and composed, strong at her core, and ready to spread her wings to the world.

たった今、さゆきが日本代表としてクローズドドア・インタビューに挑んでいます🇯🇵
皆さま、応援よろしくお願いいたします🤍

世界大会のインタビュー衣装として、静けさと知性を感じさせながら、その内側にある強さと、世界へ羽ばたいていく意志を表現しました。

白を基調としたシャープなジレスタイルに黒のパンツを合わせ、凛とした佇まいに。

肩から長く流れるケープには、墨絵を思わせる鶴と金の円を配置し、静止している時には端正に、動いた時には鶴が大きく羽ばたくように見えるデザインにしています。

日本らしい余白や筆の流れを大切にしながら、
「静かで知性的でありながら、芯には強さを持ち、世界へ羽ばたいていく」
そんな姿を一着の中に形にしました。

日本初の女性総理大臣である高市総理を表敬訪問させていただくという、大変貴重な機会となりました。

懇談では、世界大会への出場を前に温かい激励のお言葉をいただくとともに、日本の魅力を世界へ発信していくことについて、そして「女性として」という枠にとらわれず、一人の人間、一人のリーダーとしてどうあるべきか、高市総理が考えるリーダー像についてもお話を伺うことができ、多くの学びと気づきをいただきました。

Magdaline Cherestal’s childhood was not easy. Growing up in Haiti, she experienced difficult moments that shaped her strength, resilience, and compassion for others. At just five years old, she witnessed the devastating impact of the January 12, 2010 earthquake, a magnitude 7.0 disaster that claimed more than 220,000 lives according to Haiti’s official estimates and forced over a million people to leave their homes.

As she grew older, life continued to present challenges, but these experiences taught her the importance of perseverance, faith, and hope. Her childhood helped her understand that even in the darkest moments, people can find the courage to rebuild and support one another. Today, these lessons inspire her to serve her community, empower young people, and use her voice to create positive change. Her story is a reminder that difficult beginnings do not define a person’s future; they can become the foundation of a life dedicated to making a difference.

It deeply saddens me to witness them consumed by flames and toxic crude, yet we cannot turn away.

Miss Earth is not always about glamour; it’s about advocacy. In line with our theme, “Love in Action", Miss Earth transcends beauty and pageantry by inspiring meaningful action through environmental protection, sustainable education, community outreach, and climate change advocacy.

It means standing in the gap when our land is bleeding and using our platform to fight for real change.

This tragedy is happening now, in real time, and our environment needs us to turn empathy into impact. Join us in standing together for immediate restoration and long-term protection of our precious wetlands. 

Our ecosystems deserve our care, and our people deserve a safe, sustainable home.

De8YE09ksm3.caption:
Earth Day in Action for a Cleaner Coast

A few days before Earth Day, we chose to do something rather than simply talk about it.

At Foz do Arelho, I joined a large community beach and lagoon clean-up that brought together around 100 people. Together, we removed approximately 548 kg of waste from the area, waste that could otherwise have remained in or reached the lagoon and the ocean.

Beyond the numbers, this activity helped me understand what happens to the waste we leave behind. Plastic does not simply disappear. It can fragment into smaller particles, enter aquatic ecosystems, affect marine life and eventually become part of the food chain.

That made me look differently at something as simple as a piece of plastic left on the sand. What we leave behind has a journey, and its impact can continue long after we walk away.

Foz do Arelho is part of the place I call home. Caring for it means more than keeping a beach clean, it means protecting the lagoon, the ocean, the biodiversity they support and, ultimately, ourselves.

As Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I want to be part of environmental action that I can experience and understand firsthand. And this day showed me the true power of collective action, around 100 people, approximately 548 kg of waste removed, and one ecosystem left cleaner than we found it.

Earth Day may come once a year. Our responsibility does not.

Bárbara Costa | Miss Earth Portugal 2026

Dex3IZ3CNyH.caption:
The Water Cycle in Action

On World Water Day, I visited the Salinas de Rio Maior to explore a remarkable example of how the water cycle connects nature, geology and our everyday lives.

Here, rainwater infiltrates the ground and travels through layers of rock, reaching underground deposits of rock salt that naturally make the water saline. At the surface, sun, wind and evaporation gradually leave behind salt crystals, while the water returns to its natural cycle, a process that has supported salt production here for centuries.

Something as familiar as the salt on our table is therefore the result of an extraordinary natural journey, connecting water, geology, natural resources and human tradition.

As Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I believe protecting water also begins with understanding the processes it makes possible and recognizing how deeply our lives depend on them.

From rain, through the Earth, to salt, every drop is part of a much bigger story.

DejRMAODiHp.caption:
Does anyone else love desserts like cake or cookies? Today I want to introduce another way we can care for our Earth. I've always loved desserts—but recently I started discovering vegan desserts, which let me enjoy something I love while also being kinder to the planet. That’s why I want to introduce a well-known vegan dessert café in Korea, Plant Bakery Seoul plantbakeryseoul 🍰

Let me share why vegan desserts and bakeries make such a positive impact on our Earth 

🌾Plant-Based Baking, Lighter on the Earth
Traditional baking relies heavily on dairy, eggs, and butter — ingredients tied to animal agriculture, one of the biggest contributors to greenhouse gas emissions. Vegan bakeries replace these with plant-based alternatives, significantly reducing their environmental footprint.

💧Saving Water, One Bake at a Time
Producing dairy and eggs requires enormous amounts of water. By using plant-based ingredients like oat milk, almond butter, and flax eggs, vegan desserts help conserve one of our Earth‘s most precious resources.

🐄Reducing the Impact of Animal Agriculture
Choosing vegan desserts means choosing not to support industrial animal farming — a major source of deforestation, methane emissions, and land degradation. Every bite becomes a small but meaningful act of care for the Earth.

♻Mindful, Sustainable Ingredients
Many vegan bakeries, like Plant Bakery Seoul, focus on natural, sustainably sourced ingredients — supporting a food culture that's better for both our bodies

DeYijN3DXo2.caption:
Underwater Lagoon – A Cocoon of Biodiversity

As part of my role as Miss Earth Portugal 2026, I had the privilege of attending the opening of the photographic exhibition “Lagoa Subaquática – Um Casulo de Biodiversidade” (“Underwater Lagoon – A Cocoon of Biodiversity”) in Foz do Arelho, an environmental education initiative promoted by the Municipality of Caldas da Rainha.

Through 20 underwater photographs, the exhibition reveals a reality that often remains hidden beneath the waters of Óbidos Lagoon: an ecosystem rich in biodiversity, where seagrass meadows play an essential role in the reproduction, feeding, and development of different species of fish, crustaceans, and molluscs.

As a partner of the Caldas da Rainha Environmental Department, participating in this eco-activity allowed me to gain a closer understanding of the biodiversity of a territory that I also represent, while contributing to raising awareness within the community about the importance of its conservation.

Because protecting nature also begins with knowing it. And bringing to light what exists beneath the surface is a way of bringing people closer to nature and showing them the value of what we have right here, so close to us.

DciI95GzKG_.caption:
To the brave families and people of Nepal,

Our hearts are heavy with sorrow following the devastating calamity that struck your beautiful nation last Wednesday. On behalf of the entire Miss Earth global family, we are reaching out to share our deepest sympathies, unwavering solidarity, and heartfelt prayers during this time of profound grief and uncertainty.

At Miss Earth, we believe that our connection to the planet is inseparable from our connection to one another. When the earth trembles and brings hardship to a community, the pain is felt across the globe. We are mourning with you for the precious lives lost, and we are holding space in our hearts for those who are injured, displaced, and grieving.

Please know that you are not alone. The Miss Earth organization, along with our titleholders, partners, and supporters worldwide, sends our most earnest prayers for the swift recovery of the wounded and comfort for the brokenhearted. We also pray for strength, safety, and guidance for the rescue workers and volunteers who are tirelessly helping in the aftermath. 

The resilience, grace, and enduring spirit of the Nepali people have always been an inspiration to the world. Though the ground may have shaken, the strength of your community remains unshakable. 

We stand with you in prayer, in spirit, and in support, today and in the days of healing and rebuilding ahead. 

With deepest sympathy and endless prayers,

The Miss Earth Family

Miss World Joheirry Mola visited The People’s Theatre (thepeoplestheatrenyc) in Inwood, New York City, where she was welcomed by Mino Lora, the theatre’s Dominican-born co-founder and executive artistic director, and New York City Council Member Carmen De La Rosa. Carmen moved from the Dominican Republic to New York as a child and grew up in Inwood, one of the neighborhoods she now represents in District 10.

Joheirry toured the Centro Cultural Inmigrante, the theatre’s first permanent home, which opened in September 2026. The center brings performances, rehearsal studios, and arts education together under one roof. It gives immigrant artists a place to develop and present new work and offers young people in Inwood and neighboring Washington Heights the chance to tell their own stories through theatre.

After the tour, Joheirry joined Mino and Carmen for a conversation with guests and members of the press. During the Q&A, a young woman told Joheirry she had been bullied for being of Dominican descent. What would she do in her place?

Joheirry encouraged her to be proud of her roots and of where her family came from, wherever she might find herself. No country is perfect, she said, and every country has something special to share with the world. She encouraged the young woman to speak about being Dominican with pride, even when someone tried to use it to hurt her. 

Thank you to Mino, Carmen, and The People’s Theatre for welcoming Miss World and making room for such an honest

Nearly 400 students gave Miss World Joheirry Mola a superstar welcome when she visited P.S. 132 Juan Pablo Duarte in New York this week. But once she sat down between the two students chosen to interview her, the questions were all about school. One of them put her on the spot. What was her least favorite subject?

Mola told the children she loved social studies, especially history, and admitted that she sometimes struggled with math. Her young interviewers had a follow-up. What did she do about it?

She told them that when she got home from school, she spent more time studying math than her other subjects. It took extra work to earn the grades she wanted, and she encouraged the children to do the same when they found a subject difficult. They could have their favorites, she said, and still give themselves a chance to learn something in every class.

Mola also encouraged the students to stay true to themselves, stay focused on their goals, and respect their parents and teachers. After the conversation, the children formed a long line for autographs. She signed nearly 400 photos, making time for each child and posing with those who asked for a picture.

A teacher herself, Mola has made education a priority during her reign. Through Voices of Tomorrow, her Beauty With a Purpose project, she helps children and teenagers in underserved communities learn English and gain the confidence to speak it. She also has a dream for the future in the Dominican Republic.

Earlier this week, Miss World Joheirry Mola visited United Nations Headquarters in New York, where she was welcomed by Dr. Felipe Paullier, the UN’s Assistant Secretary-General for Youth Affairs. Their conversation focused on access to education in Latin America and other developing regions, as well as the importance of supporting young people’s mental health.

Paullier, a Uruguayan physician trained in pediatrics, was 32 when he took office in 2023, becoming the youngest senior appointee in UN history. During the meeting, he stressed the importance of making it easier for young people to talk about their mental health and seek support. It is an issue he worked on in Uruguay, where, as director of the National Youth Institute, he helped launch Ni Silencio, Ni Tabú, a campaign backed by UNICEF that encourages open conversations about mental health among adolescents and young adults.

Mola spoke about Julia Morley CBE’s work through Beauty With a Purpose and shared how her own experience as a teacher shaped Voices of Tomorrow. Through the project, she helps children and teenagers in underserved communities learn English and build the confidence to use it.

Following the meeting, Mola toured United Nations Headquarters at the invitation of Ambassador Wellington Bencosme, the Dominican Republic’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations. Passaic Welcomes Miss World Joheirry Mola Back to the City Where She Was Born

When Joheirry Mola Domínguez walked into Passaic City Hall on November 7, she was greeted by live music, Dominican flags and a surprise from Mayor Hector C. Lora. He had invited doctors from St. Mary’s General Hospital, where Joheirry was born, including physicians who may have helped deliver her. 

It was one of the most special moments of the reception. Joheirry’s grandparents and aunt were there to share it with her, while her mother, Heiddy Domínguez, watched on her phone. Visibly moved, Joheirry thanked the mayor and the community for welcoming her back to the New Jersey city where her life began.

Local officials, law enforcement representatives and Dominican community leaders joined the celebration, along with Mr. José Francisco Santana Suriel, the Consul General of the Dominican Republic in New Jersey. Passaic honored the reigning Miss World with a key to the city, an official proclamation and recognition as a Distinguished Ambassador of Passaic. The hospital also presented her with a special recognition. For Lora, the occasion had a connection of its own. The son of Dominican immigrants, he worked at St. Mary’s for more than 14 years before entering politics.

Today is October 25, that special date when the World comes together to celebrate JEM’s birthday.

Julia Morley CBE is a remarkable woman whose compassion has helped generations of young women discover their potential and use their talents to make a difference. Through Beauty With a Purpose, she created a platform that turns concern for others into action, bringing care, opportunity, and hope to people in need around the world.

In 2022, Queen Elizabeth II recognized her charitable and voluntary service to disadvantaged people in the United Kingdom and abroad by appointing her a Commander of the Order of the British Empire, the honor represented by the letters CBE.

Those who know Julia understand how deeply she cares for children. She believes no child should go hungry or grow up without protection, love, and the encouragement to become everything they dream of being. That belief is at the heart of her life’s work.

For the women who join Miss World, JEM is also a source of strength and reassurance. She cares for them as she would her own daughters, shares in their joys, and celebrates their achievements and important steps long after their time on the Miss World stage.

Today, we celebrate her life, her generous heart, her humor, and the countless lives she has touched. We also celebrate the woman we are so fortunate to know and love.

Happy Birthday, dear JEM. Much love from your Miss World family all around the globe!

Dd_8WcOpaUF.caption:
In Santiago de los Caballeros, Miss World Joheirry Mola immersed herself in Dominican culture, history, art, and identity, visiting two cultural centers before ending her day at one of the city’s most recognizable landmarks.

Her visit started at Centro Cultural Eduardo León Jimenes (centroleonrd), where art, history, and exhibitions invite visitors to discover the diversity of Dominican identity and the traditions that have shaped the nation.

At Centro Cultural Banreservas (centroculturalbr), a space dedicated to preserving cultural heritage and supporting artistic talent, she visited “Orgánico y Desenfadado,” a retrospective of Dominican artist Persio Checo. His paintings and sculptures draw on surrealism, nature, and the sea, creating an imaginative world of color and organic forms. On their final day of official activities in Vietnam, Miss World 2026 Joheirry Mola, First Runner-Up Elisabeth Reynés and Second Runner-Up Taanusiya Chetty discovered three very different sides of Nha Trang: its extraordinary island environment, marine heritage and centuries-old culture.

The day began with a journey by sea to Hòn Nội, known as Yến Island, one of Khánh Hòa’s swiftlet islands. During several hours on the island, the Top 3 explored its coastal landscape and learned about the traditional bird’s nest industry, an important part of Khánh Hòa’s cultural and economic heritage.

Their visit included Hòn Sam swiftlet cave, where they discovered more about the birds, their nesting environment and the traditional methods associated with harvesting the highly prized edible nests. They also took part in an incense-offering ceremony at the temple honoring the ancestral figure of Khánh Hòa’s bird’s nest profession. 

Surrounded by turquoise water, rocky cliffs and spectacular views, the visit combined discovery with a little adventure. After approximately 90 minutes traveling by sea to reach the island, the Top 3 spent the morning exploring, filming and enjoying a side of Khánh Hòa that few international visitors have the opportunity to experience. They also shared lunch on the island before making the journey back to Nha Trang.

The Top 3 Miss World 2026 joined a special early celebration of Tết Trung Thu, Vietnam’s traditional Mid-Autumn Festival, at the Khánh Hòa Provincial Children’s Cultural Palace in Nha Trang.

Known in Vietnam as the Children’s Festival, Tết Trung Thu is one of the country’s most cherished traditions, bringing families and communities together through colorful lanterns, music, lion and dragon dances, mooncakes and celebrations dedicated especially to children. 

Miss World 2026 Joheirry Mola, First Runner-Up Elisabeth Reynes Alabern and Second Runner-Up Taanusiya Veerapandian enjoyed the festivities alongside the children, joining the celebrations and sharing a joyful evening filled with performances and traditional Mid-Autumn activities.

Joheirry also addressed the children and guests, sharing a few words on behalf of the Top 3 before the three joined the gift presentation.

A total of 1,500 gifts were prepared for children across Khánh Hòa. Five hundred were presented directly during the celebration, while another 1,000 were sent to children at shelters, care facilities and social protection centers across the northern part of the province. 

The occasion also brought the Top 3 back to a familiar place. During the 75th Anniversary Miss World Festival, the Khánh Hòa Children’s Cultural Palace welcomed the National Ambassadors for some of the competition’s memorable events, including the Head-to-Head Challenge and Talent Competition.

In Round 2, the two highest-voted national ambassadors will secure direct places in the Top 12. Voting will then continue for the final opportunity to earn a guaranteed place in the Top 6!

Keep supporting your favorite at https://missworld.1voting.com/

Dc3kV6hpl4H.caption:
Reigning Mr World Danny Mejía will co-host the 75th Anniversary Miss World Final alongside the 66th Miss World, Stephanie del Valle!

Danny made his debut as a presenter during this year’s Miss World Festival, quickly winning audiences over with his charisma, confidence and natural presence while hosting social media content and preliminary events, including the Talent and Top Model Challenges.

Now, he is ready for the biggest stage of them all!

The show will happen on Saturday, September 5, at 7 PM Vietnam time, live from Nha Trang.

#missworld #beautywithapurpose

The Multimedia Final Challenge took place earlier today, September 3, introducing a completely new and original format to the competition.

The four continental winners were welcomed by reigning Mr World Danny Mejía, who explained the challenge before inviting them into a room where six very special guests were waiting:

Miss World 2025, Opal Suchata Chuangsri
Miss World 2024, Krystyna Pyszková
Miss World 2022, Karolina Bielawska
Miss World 2018, Vanessa Ponce de León
Miss World 2016, Stephanie Del Valle
Miss World 1988, Linda Pétursdóttir
Miss World 1975, Wilnelia Merced Forsyth

Each Miss World was seated at a different station, and the finalists had four minutes with each of them. They were free to ask any questions they wished and capture photos, selfies and videos. Once time was called, they moved on to the next station, continuing until each finalist had spoken with all six titleholders.

With five additional minutes allowed for any final shots or adjustments, the finalists are now using the material they collected to create a two-minute video celebrating Miss World’s 75-year history through the stories and experiences shared by these remarkable women.

The completed videos must be submitted by 11:59 PM tonight. One of the four finalists will be named the overall Multimedia Award winner during the Miss World Final on September 5 and will earn a fast-track place in the Top 20.

The 4 Multimedia Challenge Continental Winners are audreyhowentsaioff 🇬🇫, adahmushibi 🇿🇲, juli

DcyiTNzOfGx.caption:
On September 2, all 111 Miss World national ambassadors took to the spectacular stage in Nha Trang to showcase their national costumes and traditional dances in a vibrant celebration of culture, heritage and unity.

Held as Vietnam celebrated the 81st anniversary of its independence, “Hello Vietnam, Hello World” brought nations together through color, music and movement. Just three days before the Miss World Final and the celebration of Miss World’s 75-year history, each national ambassador proudly shared the traditions and spirit of her homeland.

Among those in attendance were Julia Morley CBE, President and Chairwoman of the Miss World Organization; representatives of the Sen Vàng host committee; and Miss World titleholders Opal Suchata Chuangsri, Miss World titleholders Krystyna Pyszková, Karolina Bielawska, Vanessa Ponce de León, Linda Pétursdóttir and Lady Wilnelia Merced Forsyth. National directors from more than 100 countries, sponsors, and the families and friends of the national ambassadors also joined the celebration.

Hosted by reigning Mr World Danny Mejía and the 66th Miss World, Stephanie del Valle, the unforgettable event welcomed an audience of approximately 10,000 people.

It was truly a night to remember!

What they read next changed everything:

The surprise led to emotional and unforgettable reactions before the four winners came together to celebrate this incredible achievement.

The Miss World stage is taking shape in Nha Trang!

DcpHR5gSLNn.caption:
Congratulations to Lê Nguyễn Bảo Ngọc of Vietnam, who secured a place in the Top 40 after winning the Asia and Oceania Top Model title. If she is named the overall Top Model winner, she will be fast-tracked to the Top 20. The result will be revealed during the final event on September 5.

As Vietnam hosts Miss World for the first time, during the festival’s historic 75th anniversary, the country has every reason to be proud of Lê Nguyễn Bảo Ngọc. She not only secured a quarterfinal spot on home soil but also earned Vietnam its seventh consecutive placement. Well done!

#MissWorld #BeautyWithAPurpose #SenVang #GELEXIMCO #VocoSceniaBayNhaTrang

DcpGF7Bytax.caption:
Congratulations to Indira Ampiot of France, who secured a place in the Top 40 after winning the European Top Model title. If she is named the overall Top Model winner, she will be fast-tracked to the Top 20. The result will be revealed during the final event on September 5.

France has won the Miss World title once, with Denise Perrier’s victory in 1953. However, the country has placed in eight of the last 10 editions, including two first runner-up finishes, an impressive record!

#MissWorld #BeautyWithAPurpose #SenVang #GELEXIMCO #VocoSceniaBayNhaTrang

DcpEfS7y4VC.caption:
Congratulations to Soye Karibi-George of Nigeria, who secured a place in the Top 40 after winning the Africa Top Model title. If she is named the overall Top Model winner, she will be fast-tracked to the Top 20. The result will be revealed during the final event on September 5.

Nigeria will aim to win its second Miss World title with Soye Karibi-George, following Agbani Darego’s historic triumph in 2001. With Soye’s accomplishment, Nigeria advances to the next round of the competition for the third consecutive year. Well done!

#missworld #BeautyWithPurpose #SenVang #GELEXIMCO #VocoSceniaBayNhaTrang

DcpDZmrzntm.caption:

The Dominican Republic continues its strong momentum at Miss World, as Joheirry has now earned the country its fourth consecutive placement. Well done!

#missworld #BeautyWithPurpose #SenVang #GELEXIMCO #VocoSceniaBayNhaTrang

DcnsGjeJ5mQ.caption:
The candidates from Asia and Oceania took to the runway, bringing confidence, elegance and attitude as they showcased stunning fashion creations during the Miss World Top Model competition.

DcnhwnfCd98.caption:
World Designer Award - Vietnam - Lê Nguyễn Bảo Ngọc

This design creates a striking visual impression with its majestic, flowing silhouette, crafted entirely from eco-friendly, natural bio-materials. The soft pink palette combined with the soaring dove detail conveys a timeless message of peace and life. Its true power lies in humanistic green fashion: a seamless union of couture craftsmanship and environmental protection that leaves a profound, lasting impression. Designed by Nguyen Phuc Tuan.

Top Model Winner in Asia and Oceania 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnhfKniWKa.caption:
World Designer Award - Türkiye - Sıla Saraydemir 

The Seven Hills —is a couture gown inspired by the timeless beauty, history, and romance of Istanbul. Drawing on the iconic Galata Tower, a symbol of love and destiny in Turkish folklore, the design incorporates seven elegant arches representing the city’s legendary Seven Hills and delicate tulip motifs that honour the artistic legacy of the Ottoman era. Flowing from a sophisticated halter neckline into an ethereal cape, the gown captures the movement and spirit of a city where continents, cultures, and civilizations meet. Designed by L’Atelier Blanc latelierblancistanbul 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnhH6fCVAV.caption:
World Designer Award - Thailand - Kanteera Techaphattanakul

This dress was made by thai silk called "Mudmee Silk" burgundy red top was deconstruction line and patchwork with hill tribe local fabric embroidery on top with "Jewel beetle wings" embroidered. And bottom of dress was embroidered with many beads for sparkle inspiration all from Thai her majesty queen. Designed by Petch Boutique.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

Dcng5XeiSTy.caption:
World Designer Award - Sri Lanka - Prathibha Liyanaarachchi

This gown features hand-layered petals symbolizing growth and perseverance, flowing over soft organza that reflects the beauty and movement of water. Thousands of individually hand-set crystals add light and texture, while a detachable cape creates the impression of petals unfolding with every step. Designed as a tribute to Miss Sri Lanka’s journey and the women she has uplifted through her Beauty with a Purpose, this dress celebrates transformation, empowerment, and the strength that emerges through life's challenges. Desgined by Gunidu Dasun.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcngXgriSUn.caption:
World Designer Award - Singapore - Aishwarya Nicole Tan

This gown features a fitted corseted silhouette adorned with intricate crystal and beadwork that creates a soft shimmer with every movement. An oversized pink tulle train adds volume and drama, while the contrast between the structured bodice and flowing layers brings together softness and strength. Chosen by Miss Singapore, the soft pink palette and striking silhouette reflect elegance, confidence, and resilience on stage. Designed by Mai Phuong Trang.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcngDlHCfEG.caption:
World Designer Award - Philippines - Asia Rose SimpsonBest 

Inspired by the beauty of the Philippine seas, this dusty blue gown features an elegant off-the-shoulder silhouette with a detachable tulle train. Adorned with Swarovski crystals, glass beads, French lace, and intricate embroidery, the design shimmers like ocean waves, creating a graceful and captivating presence on stage. Designed by Benj Leguiab IV.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcndzaGCcN7.caption:
World Designer Award - Pakistan - Anniqa Jamal Iqbal

Featuring a corset-style bodice, a slim floor-length skirt, and a sheer draped panel over one shoulder, this design combines delicate fabrics with intricate embellishment. Created from organza chiffon, mesh, and tulle, the gown is decorated with rhinestones, crystals, pearls, and sequins that add texture and detail throughout. A side cut-out with fine vertical straps enhances the design, while floral motifs on the skirt provide an elegant finishing touch. Designed by _pelhure 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcndjxAiXIi.caption:
World Designer Award - New Zealand - Chloe Robinson

Crafted in rich embroidered red shot silk, the gown features intricate fabric manipulation and structured corsetry, showcasing the artistry and craftsmanship of New Zealand fashion. Its dramatic silhouette and rich detailing reflect the designer’s distinctive approach to couture-creative, theatrical and deeply connected to Aotearoa’s unique fashion identity. Designed by Liz Mitchell.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcndGPCiRRm.caption:
World Designer Award - Nepal - Luna Luitel

This striking black gown is inspired by the agricultural landscapes of Nepal and Vietnam, featuring a bold silhouette that reflects the strength and beauty of both nations. The deep black color symbolizes Nepal’s fertile Kalo Mato (black soil), the foundation of growth and harvest. With its flowing design and nature-inspired details, the gown serves as a cultural bridge between the two countries, celebrating their shared connection to the land, heritage, and enduring spirit. Designed by NhaMot.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

Dcnc6IJibHH.caption:
World Designer Award - Myanmar - Han Theint Theint Aung

This gown is inspired by the iconic Vietnamese Đèn Lồng lantern. Its structured silhouette reflects the lantern’s distinctive shape and framework, while the grey and black colour palette adds a modern, dramatic edge. The skirt features floral motifs inspired by the decorative paintings commonly seen on traditional Vietnamese lanterns. By combining these cultural design elements with contemporary fashion, the gown pays tribute to Vietnam’s heritage in a sophisticated and elegant way. Designed by Lin Htet Nyi Nyi.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcncklLCSh1.caption:
World Designer Award - Mongolia - Enkhtuul Bayarsaikhan

Inspired by the flow of water, this gown is crafted from satin, mesh, and glittery chiffon in light blue with hints of royal blue. A mermaid style with a built-in corset, adorned with intricate embellishments from head to toe. The hand-sewn crystal and bead embellishments represent the preciousness and value of water. A flowing chiffon skirt together with a detachable chiffon cape evokes the Mongolian wind sweeping freely across the open steppe, creating a design that beautifully combines symbolism, craftsmanship, and elegance. Designed by Maralmaa Batbold - Precious fashion house.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcncQQZCbo8.caption:
World Designer Award - Maldives - Mariyam Eema Mohamed

Whispers of the Sea is crafted from iridescent organza, pearl tulle, and silk satin, featuring a softly corseted silhouette with flowing draping, sheer layers, and a graceful cape. Crystals, sequins, pearls, and delicate tassels add texture and movement, while shades of ivory, pearl white, aqua blue, and blush lilac reflect the beauty of the ocean. Designed by Aishath Najwa.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

Dcnbr_fCSsA.caption:
World Designer Award - Malaysia - Taanusiya Chetty

Inspired by the Borneo Sea, this gown features pleated chiffon in shades of turquoise, aqua, and deep blue. A fitted bodice flows into a softly draped skirt, while pearl embellishments add texture and crystal tassels create movement and sparkle. The ocean-inspired colour palette and layered construction reflect the beauty of Borneo’s coastal waters. Designed by Arma Couture.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

Dcnau2hiWKi.caption:
World Designer Award - Lebanon - Perla Harb

From the Liberté En Soie Spring Summer 2026 collection, the look is a dusty pink strapless gown inspired by the hazy glamour of the Roaring Twenties, featuring a sequined corset with delicate draping and a fluid crepe georgette silhouette that embodies feminine ease, freedom, and effortless movement. Designed by Basil Soda.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnafbuiXnQ.caption:
World Designer Award - Laos - Mongkoutphet Hanesana 

This gown takes inspiration from the white peacock and is crafted from traditional Lao silk, featuring embroidered peacock-inspired motifs throughout the fabric. The design is presented in a soft blue shade and features a structured silhouette accented by a dramatic sculptural bow and an extended train, creating volume and balance. The combination of intricate embroidery, refined tailoring, and statement construction highlights the craftsmanship of Lao textile design while giving the traditional influence a contemporary interpretation. Designed by Mr Khanxay. 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnaEZSCWiq.caption:
World Designer Award - Kyrgyzstan- Saadat Rustamovna Asylbekova

This is a floor-length mermaid style gown crafted from French lace and chiffon and elegantly adorned with ostrich feathers. It features a high neckline, long fitted sleeves, delicate detail, and flowing chiffon cape panels that create graceful movement. The dramatic feathered train enhances the luxurious silhouette, while the design celebrates femininity, elegance and the artistry of Kyrgyz haute couture. Designed by Aijan Sadyrkulova
at Moon Soul fashion_by_moonsoul 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnZ3_tiXfC.caption:
World Designer Award - Korea - Cha Minseo (차민서)

This hanbok is a modern interpretation of traditional Korean dress, combining the graceful silhouette and delicate floral details of the classic hanbok with a more contemporary, fashion-forward design. The contrasting black and soft pink create a bold yet elegant look, while the shorter silhouette and sheer layered fabrics give the traditional garment a youthful, modern character. Designed by misunghanbok.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnZjFSCVYr.caption:
World Designer Award - Kazakhstan - Bagym Baltabayeva

This design is made of layers of sheer tulle and organza, with extensive hand embellishment throughout. The fitted bodice and skirt are detailed with hand-embroidered crystals, pearls, beads, and sequins, creating texture and dimension across the garment. Sculpted organza drape at the waist while hand-cut appliqué elements extend from the bodice and shoulders to enhance the overall shape. The design is finished in Kazakhstan’s signature sky blue, accented with icy silver tones that highlight the intricate detailing. Designed by Sholpan Atelier.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnZSXQCcg6.caption:
World Designer Award - Japan - Yui Kawana

This ice-blue ball gown is inspired by water with delicate spaghetti straps and a square neckline complement the fitted bodice which is adorned with floral embroidered lace and subtle sequins while feather-like fringe throughout the A line skirt adds graceful movement and texture. An adjustable lace-up corset back ensures a flattering fit, creating a romantic and elegant couture design. Designed by Tokyo Soir.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnUY_WifiH.caption:
World Designer Award - Indonesia - Audrey Bianca

This floor-length gown is crafted from silk, beaded tulle, and organza, featuring soft pink and green tones inspired by the Tabebuya blossom. Delicate floral embellishments and intricate beadwork reflect the flower’s distinctive bloom, while the design symbolizes growth, resilience, and renewal. Designed by Alfia Hizboel Alfiahizboel

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnQGfaCeKJ.caption:
World Designer Award - India - Nikita Porwal

This gown is crafted on a sheer champagne base with intricate crystal embroidery that creates a shimmering effect across the design. Sculpted panels add structure and dimension, while the combination of transparency and embellishment enhances the fluid silhouette. Delicate gloves complete the elegant look. Designed by Rohit Gandhi + Rahul Khanna.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnP0MICZ_m.caption:
World Designer Award - Cook Islands - Tiare Henry-Anguna

This gown is inspired by the turquoise waters of Manihiki Atoll and the Cook Islands’ renowned black pearls. Featuring a sculpted corset and fishtail silhouette, it is embellished with hand-sewn black pearls and iridescent mother-of-pearl shell pieces that reflect the light and movement of the ocean. The design celebrates the Cook Islands’ marine heritage and natural beauty through its intricate detailing. Designed by Annie Wigmore-Ama {Miss Cook Islands 1998} anniewigmores 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnPiABCVDh.caption:
World Designer Award - China - Dong Yifei

This gown features a standing-collar bodice with red and gold embroidery, crystal detailing, and oversized fan-inspired structures adorned with golden tassels. The burgundy shimmering skirt is finished with gold motifs, while traditional Chinese architectural elements add depth and detail throughout the design. Designed by Zhong Guiyao.

Designer Award Winner in Asia and Oceania 

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnPVwXCacJ.caption:
World Designer Award - Cambodia - Leakena IN

This gown is a bold and elegant couture design in a beautiful lime-green color. The fitted corset highlights the feminine silhouette, while the dramatic mermaid skirt creates a royal and glamorous look. The colour represents confidence, freshness, and the courage to stand out. Designed by MINH TUAN.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnOzYSibt0.caption:
World Designer Award - Bangladesh - Samanzar Sayeed 

This gown is inspired by the Aparajita flower, incorporating its rich blue tones through intricate beadwork and couture detailing. Embroidery on the sleeves and hem reflects Bangladesh’s rivers and landscapes, while woven silhouettes of women add a distinctive design element. The gown combines traditional craftsmanship with a contemporary aesthetic. Designed by Moureen Zahir.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

DcnNnbwiRzA.caption:
World Designer Award - Australia - Olivija Spanovskis

A gown inspired by the colours of the Ningaloo Reef, a UNESCO heritage site. It features a strapless fitted bodice, subtle embellishments, and a full-length liquid organza skirt with a mermaid style train. Blending coral, sand, and ocean-blue tones, the design reflects the natural beauty of the landscapes of Western Australia with paintings on the corset by Mary Zammit Art. Designed by Tasmin Jade Couture and Mary Zammit Art.

Miss World will be crowned on September 5 at 8 PM local time during a worldwide live broadcast from Nha Trang, Vietnam.

📷 MWO / Ricardo Siviero ricardo.siviero

𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐈𝐒 𝐆𝐑𝐀𝐍𝐃. ☝🏻👑

Year after year, Miss Grand International continues to move forward, raising our own standards in production, entertainment, opportunities, experiences, and the platform we create for women from around the world.

We believe that empowering women begins with giving them the freedom to be exactly who they are. There is no single image a Queen must fit into. She can be bold, funny, ambitious, outspoken, talented, glamorous, emotional, fearless, and completely herself.

For us, empowerment has never been something that exists only in statements. It is something that must be seen in action, in real opportunities, meaningful rewards, professional growth, and the support that continues long after the competition ends.

And the same principle applies to the way we work.

We believe in integrity, transparency, accountability, and building our organization through honest work and responsible actions. Trust is not something to simply ask for. It is something to earn, protect, and prove through what we do every day.

Every year, we listen.
Every year, we improve.
Every year, we aim higher.

Not by becoming someone else, but by becoming a better version of who we already are.

We have never needed to follow another definition of success. We know who we are, what we stand for, and where we are going.

We are GRAND. We are different by design. And there is only one GRAND.

WeAreGRANDthe1andOnly ☝🏻👑✨

The competition features 𝟑 𝐕𝐎𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐃𝐒, giving contestants multiple opportunities to qualify automatically for the Miss Grand International 2026 Grand Final.

🔹 𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐃 𝟏 — 𝐓𝐎𝐏 𝟐𝟎
- Uses accumulated votes since voting first opened.
- Closes at 7:00 PM (GMT+7) on Grand Final night.
- The contestant with the highest votes automatically enters the TOP 20.
- Scores reset to ZERO for Round 2.

🔹 𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐃 𝟐 — 𝐓𝐎𝐏 𝟏𝟎
- Opens after the TOP 20 announcement and closes after the Swimsuit Competition.
- ALL contestants remain eligible, including those who did not advance to the TOP 20.
- The contestant with the highest votes automatically enters the TOP 10.
- Scores reset to ZERO for Round 3.

🔹 𝐑𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐃 𝟑 — 𝐓𝐎𝐏 𝟓
- Opens after the TOP 10 announcement and closes after the Question & Answer round.
- ALL contestants remain eligible, including those who did not advance to the TOP 10.
- The contestant with the highest votes automatically enters the TOP 5, wins 𝐌𝐈𝐒𝐒 𝐏𝐎𝐏𝐔𝐋𝐀𝐑 𝐕𝐎𝐓𝐄, and is guaranteed at least 4th Runner-Up.

- Scores reset to ZERO at the start of Rounds 2 and 3. Previous votes do not carry over.

- Contestants eliminated from the main competition can still win Miss Popular Vote.

- The winner of this title is determined solely by votes received in Round 3.

A moment that will forever hold a special place in the history of Miss Supranational.

Today, 02 September 2026, Ma. Katrina Llegado, Miss Supranational 2026, was formally recognised during a session of the Congress of the Philippines, honoured not only for the crown she wears, but for the pride with which she carries the Philippines onto the world stage.

Standing beneath the Philippine flag, crowned as Miss Supranational, this image speaks louder than words. It is a moment of recognition, of representation, and of immense national pride.

From the Philippines to the world, and now, home to be honoured by her nation. 🇵🇭👑

Thank you to Hon. Brian Poe Llamanzares, FPJ Panday Bayanihan Party-list Representative and House Assistant Majority Leader and also Representative Ann Matibag, author of House Resolution No. 1402 honoring Kat for her historic Miss Supranational 2026 victory in Poland.

A Filipina. A Queen. A Supranational.

DekHBEajQmT.caption:
J-2 avant le grand reveal ✨

Vous pouvez avoir une vraie voix dans cette élection 
Vous avez jusqu’à dimanche pour voter pour votre candidate préférée sur l’application NEXVERSE. Alors si vous souhaitez me soutenir, chaque vote compte 🫶🏼

Représenter la France à Miss Universe serait un immense honneur pour moi, d’autant plus que je pourrais défendre aux côtés de planfrance une cause qui me tient énormément à cœur : l’éducation et l’indépendance des jeunes filles.

Merci pour tous vos messages et votre soutien. On y va à fond pour cette dernière ligne droite ! ❤️

DeKJxpzNxm3.caption:
On m’a souvent dit qu’il fallait choisir. Définir une voie et s’y tenir.
Moi, j’ai tout choisi.

J’ai grandi entre les études et le mannequinat, en construisant mon parcours en finance tout en voyageant et en travaillant à travers le monde. De Madrid à Londres, en passant par les États-Unis, j’ai appris très tôt à m’adapter, à travailler et à aller au bout de mes ambitions.

Avec le recul, je réalise que toutes ces expériences m’ont préparée à ce moment. Elles m’ont appris à me dépasser, à croire en mes choix et surtout à ne jamais me laisser enfermer dans une seule voie.

Aujourd’hui, je fais partie du Top 3 de missuniversefr . 
Être si proche de représenter la France à Miss Univers est une immense fierté. Si j’ai cette chance, je suis prête à me dépasser encore plus et à tout donner pour porter la France le plus loin possible.

Bravo à toutes les candidates avec qui j’ai partagé cette aventure, et merci au comité pour sa confiance et toutes ces belles rencontres.

Et surtout, merci à vous pour vos messages, votre bienveillance et votre soutien. Plus que jamais, j’ai besoin de vous à mes côtés pour cette dernière étape. ❤️

Je suis arrivée jusqu’ici en restant fidèle à celle que je suis. Maintenant, je compte bien aller jusqu’au bout. 🇫🇷✨
